findings.title: The currentTime-only compatibility path still repeatedly consumes an unchanged image
findings.closure_of_original_vectors: Original 29 independent vectors pass unchanged, including both deferred-execution paths and the real canvas/engine bridge. Native first-frame and six original native race trials pass. New forced immutable-input races reach the delayed work boundary and pass in both paths.
findings.remaining_trigger: VideoFrame is unavailable and playback-quality counters are unavailable or unusable, selecting the existing currentTime compatibility branch. The native video playhead advances while a one-frame MediaStream continues to display its original image. RAF marks every changed playhead as new input; delayed rVFC reconciliation also repeats the same consumed image when playhead and mediaTime differ.
minimal_reproduction: Use a native canvas.captureStream(0), draw one red frame, attach/play video and request one frame. Wait until native rVFC reports mediaTime 0 / presentedFrames 1.

Represent the documented capability-absence path by removing VideoFrame, requestVideoFrameCallback and getVideoPlaybackQuality from the product-visible environment. Keep a saved native VideoFrame constructor only in the independent SDK observation boundary.
Release the real App model initialization and run the production scheduler/engine against that single native source frame.

After 2300 ms, observe 140 successful SDK entries, retained input observations all at intrinsic image timestamp 0 with the same red pixels, inference display 60.6 FPS, and performance state still measuring.
Run immutable and live-quality controls: each consumes the same one-frame input once. A separately forced delayed native race without VideoFrame/quality repeats the same image in both callback paths.
findings.observed: Actual app compatibility test: 2 pass / 1 fail; currentTime-only case expected one SDK entry, received 140. A previous 650 ms observation received 41 calls and 61.1 FPS. Native still-source matrix: 5 pass / 1 fail, RAF time-only 23 calls before the second image and 44 total. Forced native race matrix: 4 pass / 2 fail; time-only rVFC and RAF each read byte-identical pixels at the same intrinsic timestamp twice.
findings.expected: Infer a usable source image once, accept genuinely subsequent input, and let input aging/stalled state advance when no new image arrives. A running playhead alone must not be taken as new source frames.
findings.impact: Unbounded repetition of synchronous inference on a stalled image and continuous resetting of input age. The collector arithmetic measures the repeated successful calls correctly; this is a frame-identity/input-aging defect, not an arithmetic error. It is stronger than documented coarse-clock coalescing.
correction_acceptance: Repair the explicitly implemented currentTime-only path so an unchanged source image is not inferred repeatedly and cannot keep input age fresh.

If exact source identity cannot be supported for a capability combination, expose a deliberate unsupported/stopped state instead of silently producing repeated inference; any narrowing of the original compatibility contract requires owner agreement.
Retain capability-absence regressions with a native still MediaStream and actual production App/engine/scheduler. Observe actual SDK input, not only callback metadata or quality counters.
Verify delayed rVFC and RAF paths without VideoFrame/quality, bootstrap/late-arrival races, subsequent frames, and expiration after no new source image.

Preserve immutable-path single consumption, F02 closure, handle/token ownership and the complete existing validation, then provide new frozen HEAD/tree and exact-HEAD hosted matched Chromium logs for independent re-review.

closure_evidence: Original native one-frame probe rerun unchanged: rVFC 1 / RAF 1 with first mediaTime 0, presentedFrames 1 and readyState 4.
Unchanged independent 29-case suite passes including first-frame startup and generation invalidation.
Eight ordinary browser cases pass, including actual App pre-presented image, model gate, equal-time camera restarts and bootstrap/arrival race.
New actual-app immutable and live-quality static-frame controls each infer once; new immutable handle/ownership boundaries pass.
findings.closure_limit: This closes first-frame acquisition at the reviewed checkpoint. It does not close residual F01 duplicates in currentTime-only compatibility.

nonblocking_observations.description: Replacement rVFC pending work can require another arrival after an older Promise job releases the lock. Real production inference remains synchronous. No Worker migration is requested.

nonblocking_observations.status: original coverage gap substantially addressed; compatibility gap remains
nonblocking_observations.description: New normal browser tests observe immutable SDK input and ready-first-frame startup. The unchanged original native race probe can bootstrap before its contention boundary, so its green result alone is insufficient. New forced-delay probes verify that boundary independently and reveal the remaining capability-absence defect.
